output.reason: [ev-689bc0108c6c] says tls.caOptional was removed from the ForwardAuth middleware and from the HTTP, Consul, Etcd, Redis, ZooKeeper, Consul Catalog and Docker providers. The proposed exposure checks only traefik.io Middleware CRDs (spec.forwardAuth.tls.caOptional), so it misses every environment that sets the option on a provider. The evidence never names the provider option paths or the flag/env-var names, and no config sources are listed, so a complete correction would mean guessing those identities. The CRD validator also reports that spec.forwardAuth.tls.caOptional is still in the v3.0.0 Middleware schema. Needed: the exact provider option keys and the places this product reads them (CLI flags, env vars, static config file).
